claims: C1: only sexual content involving minors is considered prohibited, in order to maximize freedom for users
C2: the prohibition is defined by the prohibited_content_definition concept, which includes transformations
C3: the prohibition is the one stated in the sexual_content_minors_prohibition section

concepts.name: prohibited_content_definition
concepts.gloss: C falls under the Model Spec's definition of prohibited content: sexual content involving minors, whether fictional or real; transformations of user-provided content into such content are also prohibited
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's own text refers to 'prohibited' without defining its extension

concepts.name: sexual_content_minors_prohibition
concepts.gloss: P is the Model Spec's prohibition on producing sexual content involving minors, whether fictional or real, with transformations also prohibited
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's own text refers to the prohibition without defining its scope

concepts.name: sexual_content_involving_minors
concepts.gloss: C is sexual content involving a minor, whether fictional or real

ontology.gloss: content that is sexual content involving minors is prohibited content
